title: obs note profile input
$comment: A note's frontmatter obs mapping, the core's namespace (capabilities/profiles).

document.$comment: input-model#Chapter content: false keeps a record-only note.

bless.$comment: input-model#Bless requests: the chapter asks its reader for a verdict.

template.$comment: input-model#Templates: the manifest is a template; obs.templates checks it first against input.schema.json $defs/templateMark.

guidance.$comment: input-model#Templates: the chapter is a template node; obs.templates checks it first against input.schema.json $defs/templateGuidance.

style.$comment: The manifest's style: the name of an installed style component (architecture.md, Declared style); obs.input.declared_style checks it first.
